Самая красивая версия ТС2: Надин не одна: The most beautiful theory about SOS2: Nadine isn't alone, because she's always right there — just from the future. And she's the one leaving herself clues.
<b>Фото со спины.</b> В 1.04 Надин одна: The photo from behind. In 1.04 Nadine is alone in an empty hallway and gets a photo of herself from behind, taken a second ago. Whoever took it is standing a couple of steps away, but Nadine doesn't see anyone. Then, for the first time, the game lets you play as the Unknown. If you take another photo, their hand gets into the shot, and the skin tone matches the look the player picked for Nadine.
Неизвестный ведёт её к открытому шкафчик: The Unknown leads her to Miranda's open locker, where the hellebore is. When she sees the flower, Nadine immediately understands where her visions come from: it was the same with her grandpa.
<b>Почему она себя не видит.</b> Позже Н: Why she can't see herself. Later Nadine even sees Miranda's ghost, but here there's nothing. It looks like two versions of the same person just can't meet. If Nadine had seen herself, she'd have been scared, wouldn't have gone to the locker, and none of what happened next would have happened.

Как устроено время: линии, миры и «Тьма»: How time works: lines, worlds and “Dark”
<b>Мнимое время.</b> Это понятие звучит: Imaginary time. The term comes up as early as 1.01 in class, and Darren explains it in 1.18. Imaginary time, he says, is used as a handy calculation trick, but that doesn't mean it can't exist. “We're used to thinking of time as a straight line. But physics allows that our line is just one of the axes.” The Tower, he thinks, transforms time: by stepping through the door, Nadine chose a different direction and “slipped off the line”. “To you it looks like traveling to the past, but really you just entered a different point of the same structure.”
<b>Одновременность.</b> Игра и правда ра: Simultaneity. The game really does show this again and again. In 1.05 Nadine at the junkyard says “Everything will be fine”, and right after her, Nadine in Old Saintfour says the same thing. In 1.15 the scene repeats word for word. As if both are happening at the same time.
<b>Знак в лавке.</b> В 1.16 на стене у м: The sign in the shop. In 1.16 there's a wooden plate on Mrs. Hill's wall: three interlaced loops with a flower in the middle. It's the symbol from the series “Dark”, where three times are tied into one loop. Only here there's a flower in the center, and in Saintfour the key to time is hellebore.
Как именно это работает, есть две версии: There are two versions of how exactly it works.
<b>Одна линия, много дверей.</b> Прошлое: One line, many doors. Past, present and future lie on one line, and the doors in the Tower lead to important dates: 1986, 1996 and so on. The future affects the past just as the past affects the future. Then someone from the future could have interfered in 1986, and in this line Sarah never defeated the evil.
<b>Два зеркальных мира.</b> Мир Сары и м: Two mirror worlds. Sarah's world and Nadine's world. The people in them are the same, but the events are reversed. Sarah laid Pisadeira to rest, John was stopped, the Masked Man left. Nadine had none of that. The Tower is a bridge between the worlds, and both can only be saved if they pass on what they know to each other. In “Dark”, both worlds were born from a third, broken one.
<b>Нулевой километр.</b> В ТС2 есть кадр: Ground zero. In SOS2 there's a shot of Sarah's group of four standing as stone statues overgrown with hellebore. Maybe that's the point where time broke.

Откуда видения и тени на плёнке: Where the visions and the shadows on film come from
<b>Началось с Миранды.</b> В 1.01 Надин: It started with Miranda. In 1.01 Nadine sees a shadow behind her, then a silhouette in the school restroom. Miranda's house smells sweet and acrid. Then it gets worse: a deer in an alley, a spider-like creature by a truck at the junkyard. And every time, there are purple flowers nearby.
<b>Пыльца.</b> Миранда была в Старом Сен: Pollen. Miranda had been to Old Saintfour, right at the anomaly. There was hellebore in her locker, pollen settled on her clothes and things, and later Nadine touched her tapes and camera. In SOS1 the sap of this flower is the base of CP-25, and a light touch was enough for Sarah to have nightmares for a whole season. There, hellebore is also a gateway to the World of Dreams.
<b>Но не всё — видения.</b> Тень за Мира: But not everything is a vision. The shadow behind Miranda showed up on Alice's film in 1.05, and everyone can see film. There are three explanations.
<b>Брак.</b> Элис снимает на плёнку и пр: A defect. Alice shoots on film and develops it by hand, says “maybe it was overexposed” and stops Nadine: “Careful, don't move it yet.” In the 19th century, mistakes like that produced “ghost photos”.
<b>Поле.</b> Даррен считает, что поле об: The field. Darren thinks the object's field gives off light the eye can't see, but film can.
<b>Кто-то правда ходит.</b> Самое просто: Someone really is there. The simplest explanation: someone really is following the girls.
<b>Это видят все.</b> В 1.15 в больнице: Everyone sees it. In 1.15 at the hospital, hellebore vines wrap around an Owl, and it happens in front of all the kids, not just Nadine.
<b>А в 1.19 плёнка молчит.</b> Надин сид: And in 1.19 the film stays silent. Nadine is sitting in her room and catches a dark silhouette out of the corner of her eye, slipping behind her.
